surprising.text: Tell your teacher something you believed as a kid that turned out to be false.
Tell your teacher one true fact that sounds completely made up.
Tell your teacher one surprising thing about yourself.
Tell your teacher the most surprising thing you've learned this month.
Ask your teacher what they would do if something impossible happened right now.

guess.text: Tell your teacher one thing that is true and one thing that is false.
Challenge your teacher to guess something you're really good at.
Describe something without saying what it is, and let your teacher guess.
Ask your teacher to guess how old you were in your favourite memory.

opinion.text: Ask your teacher one question about their childhood.
Ask your teacher if they have ever broken a bone.
Ask your teacher what their favourite season is, and why.
Ask your teacher about their favourite holiday memory.
Give your teacher a genuine compliment, then ask them to give you one back.
Tell your teacher one thing you're excited to do this weekend.
Ask your teacher for one piece of advice.

imagine.text: Ask your teacher what superpower they would choose.
Invent a brand new machine and tell your teacher what it does.
If you woke up 100 years in the future, what would you check first?
Design a new holiday and tell your teacher how people would celebrate it.
Predict one thing that will be different about the world in 10 years.

challenge.text: Make your teacher laugh in under one minute.
Teach your teacher how to do something.
Act something out without speaking, and let your teacher guess what it is.
Describe today in exactly three words, then ask your teacher to choose their favourite.
Perform something silly for your teacher for ten seconds — you choose how.

funny.text: Teach your teacher one fun fact they probably don't know.
Tell your teacher your funniest dream.
Invent a funny new word for something silly, and explain what it means.
Tell your teacher the silliest word you know, in any language.
Make up a silly excuse for being late, and tell it to your teacher.

strange.text: Tell your teacher the strangest fact you know.
Ask your teacher what the strangest thing they've ever seen was.
Tell your teacher something strange about yourself, and ask if they have anything similar.
Ask your teacher to tell you the weirdest fact they know.

amazing.text: Tell your teacher the most amazing record you've ever heard of.
Give your teacher an impossible number to guess, then reveal the real one.
Ask your teacher what world record they'd want to break.
